svg.text: One person, one assistant, a company: the layers
Human: architecture, briefs, acceptance, clients
talks in plain words; never types code; says yes or no to what is shown on a temporary address
Sessions (Claude Code, Codex)
build, deploy, verify; every "done" needs a run
several windows talk to each other before touching a shared file
Employees in Telegram
six role bots: sales, engineer, designer, security,
assistant, curator; a task feed; night routines
Memory
files + an index loaded every session; core rules apart;
an index guard that notices when a file outgrew its line
Guardrails (hooks)
foreign text is data · agents wait for a yes · no "done"
without a run · fact or guess · no visual without the critic
Watchdogs
routines that die silently · canaries for the tool loop ·
a pulse for "ran and returned garbage" · probes on change
Registry
400+ cards: what it is, where it lives, who owns it,
how to check it is alive; findings when a card goes stale
Servers and failover
a small VPS for bots and sites, the Mac as the workshop; a toggle asks for a resource and gets whichever side is alive
Delivery
temporary addresses, variant stands switched with keys, checks at five widths in two engines, a critic before every show
